method: Read the active merged ruleset through cameo_model and inspect Buildable.Prerequisites.
Treat ~!promotion (or !promotion) on a base actor as the explicit replacement marker; do not infer pairs from names or artwork.
Compare resolved HP, speed and armor; use the existing ledger default primary priced armament for nominal range, DPS and recognized warhead-class level.
Keep missing armament data and cross-type pairs unresolved rather than inventing equivalence.

pairs.metric_basis: Resolved HP/speed/armor plus the existing ledger's default primary priced armament for range/DPS/warhead class; upgrades, secondary payloads, status uptime and gameplay are excluded.

policy.meaning: This receipt identifies replacement pairs and static comparison findings. It does not remove PromotionUnitBuff, change costs, choose a discount, or certify a promotion as balanced.
policy.superiority_rule: Promotion units should be strictly better in meaningful stats; lower speed can be a heavier-chassis exception, longer reload can trade for greater salvo damage, and range must not be lower.

scope: Current RA1 Allies, RA1 Soviets, TD GDI and TD Nod promotion-token consumers; replacement edges come only from authored negative promotion prerequisites.
